summary: Frontend-only verification of the new MapView property clustering feature. Login OK, Map page loads, base OSM tiles render, no page/JS errors, glyphs URL is present. HOWEVER: property clustering is fully broken — the clustered 'properties' source exists with correct cluster options, setData() is invoked with 20 valid Point features, and DOM shows '20 properties on map', but the source never finishes loading (isSourceLoaded stays false, no sourcedata events fire), querySourceFeatures('properties') returns 0 at zoom 10/12/13/14/15/17/19, and NO cluster bubbles, cluster-count labels, individual pins ('prop-points') or hit targets ('prop-hit') render at any zoom. This blocks all 6 clustering acceptance checks. Additionally, [MapLibre error] AJAX/CORS errors are emitted when the raster OSM source is asked for tiles at zoom 20 (tile.openstreetmap.org has no CORS + z<=19), so the 'no [MapLibre error]' requirement is also violated.

ui_bugs.issue: Clustered GeoJSON source never becomes loaded. After selecting TEST_Territory_f7843e (20 Point features returned by /api/properties/geojson), map.isSourceLoaded('properties') stays false, no sourcedata events fire for 3+ seconds, and querySourceFeatures returns 0 features at all tested zooms (10,12,13,14,15,17,19). Consequently the prop-clusters, prop-cluster-count, prop-points and prop-hit layers render 0 features and nothing is visible on the map. The 'sample coord/geometry' payload was verified valid (all type:'Point'). setData(20-feature FeatureCollection) IS being called (verified by monkey-patching setData). Internal src._data stays {n:0,type:null} after the call. Feature is fully non-functional.

[MapLibre error] AJAXError CORS failures fetching tiles from tile.openstreetmap.org at zoom 20 (e.g. /20/271508/411184.png). tile.openstreetmap.org max native zoom is 19 and it does not send Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Requirement says zero [MapLibre error] messages. Fix: add maxzoom:19 to the 'osm' raster source (and/or clamp map maxZoom<=19) or proxy tiles via a CORS-friendly provider.

fitBounds sets maxZoom:15 which is fine, but the very first territory-selected screenshot rendered at what looks like z>=18 (single-building 'The Pinnacle' view) implying the flow ends up above the stated maxZoom (possibly a second zoom happens via map default_zoom or a wheel event) — this is what triggers the z20 tile CORS errors above.

integration_issues.flow: Select territory -> load properties geojson -> render clusters/pins
integration_issues.issue: API call succeeds (200) with 20 valid Point features and propCount UI updates to '20 properties on map', but nothing renders on the map and the clustered source never loads.

action_items: Investigate why the clustered 'properties' GeoJSON source never becomes loaded. Suspects: (a) setData being called before style is fully ready — logs earlier showed 'initMapLayers called before style loaded — deferring' pattern; if the source is added but setData runs while the worker hasn't been initialized for the source, the data may be dropped. Try awaiting map.once('idle') or map.isSourceLoaded before the first loadProperties. (b) Confirm maplibre-gl version supports cluster:true with the currently installed version; check package.json and verify supercluster worker bundling is not blocked by CSP. (c) Add a console.log in loadProperties after setData and listen for 'sourcedata' with sourceId==='properties' && isSourceLoaded to diagnose.
Add maxzoom:19 to the 'osm' raster source in baseStyle() (or clamp Map maxZoom to 19) to stop [MapLibre error] AJAXError CORS spam when the user zooms in past 19.

After fixes, re-verify: (1) cluster bubbles + white count label visible at zoom ~13, (2) individual blue/red pins visible at zoom >=17, (3) clicking a cluster zooms in (getClusterExpansionZoom), (4) clicking a pin opens PropertySheet, (5) zero [MapLibre error] messages.
critical_code_review_comments: MapView.jsx line 82-86: if territoryId is falsy, setData(empty) is called — fine. But there is no wait for the source's 'sourcedata' loaded event before assuming the source is populated. For clustered sources the worker processes the data async; consumers of the map (fitBounds/queryRenderedFeatures) should key off sourcedata isSourceLoaded===true.
MapView.jsx line 22-23: glyphs URL is present as required. Good.

MapView.jsx line 137-247: initMapLayers is idempotent via if(map.getLayer('prop-points')) return — good. But it is registered via map.on('load', ...) and also called immediately if isStyleLoaded — no styledata re-add pattern present, so once the source is added with empty data, only loadProperties()'s setData path can populate it. Any race where selectTerritory runs before initMapLayers finishes will silently drop the setData (line 81 guard returns).

baseStyle() 'osm' raster source: has tiles + tileSize but no 'maxzoom' set. When the map zoom exceeds 19, MapLibre still requests z20 tiles, and tile.openstreetmap.org has no CORS -> [MapLibre error]. Add maxzoom:19.

success_rate.frontend: 17% (1/6 acceptance checks pass: map loads. All 5 clustering-related checks fail because pins/clusters do not render.)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Selecting TEST_Territory_f7843e (id d076a49a-c8b4-4624-a9bc-11803d96d746) fits the map into downtown Nashville (~36.16,-86.78) with a 20-Point FeatureCollection returned from /api/properties/geojson. Use window fiber-walk to expose the map ref (documented in iteration_13 scripts). Key diagnostic call: `map.isSourceLoaded('properties')` — currently stays false and no sourcedata events fire. Also inspect maplibre-gl version and any CSP/worker restrictions.
rca of the issue: The 'properties' clustered GeoJSON source is added correctly with cluster:true/clusterMaxZoom:16/clusterRadius:55, and loadProperties() successfully fetches 20 valid Point features from /api/properties/geojson and calls source.setData(fc). However the source's supercluster worker never emits the sourcedata=loaded event: map.isSourceLoaded('properties') remains false, src._data stays {n:0,type:null}, querySourceFeatures returns 0 at every zoom tested, and none of the prop-* layers render any features. There are no MapLibre errors thrown to explain the failure. Most likely cause is a timing race where setData is invoked before the style/worker for the clustered source is fully initialized, or a bundling issue with maplibre-gl's supercluster worker in this build (CRA/webpack). Reproduction: login as Owner -> Map -> click TEST_Territory_f7843e -> observe DOM shows '20 properties on map' but map canvas shows zero blue/red pins or blue cluster bubbles at ANY zoom (verified 10-19). Mitigation to try first: (1) In loadProperties, after setData, await a Promise that resolves on the first 'sourcedata' with e.sourceId==='properties' && e.isSourceLoaded before allowing subsequent operations. (2) Add 'maxzoom':19 to the osm raster source in baseStyle() to eliminate the secondary [MapLibre error] CORS spam at z>=20. (3) Verify maplibre-gl version in package.json and ensure the geojson-worker chunk is being served (check Network for a maplibre worker .js request when the source is added).
